adoption_rule: No Agent coefficient or market-core adoption from this diagnostic alone. Further independent periods, policy expectations, issuer disclosures and mechanism validation remain required.
clock_rule: Cutoff is end of the second previous observed exchange trading day; the first previous day is execution reference. Rates entering before the first cutoff are inherited state, never replayed as fresh pulses.
estimator: ordinary least squares, training only, no hyperparameter search; baseline and increment use identical paired rows
limitations: Development diagnosis, not a new blind holdout or a preregistered causal study. The old Nov-Dec window and Wuhan period have been inspected in related studies.
Benchmark outcomes only; no claim of 123-company exposure mapping, issuer effects or real investor calibration.
Current historical web/data retrieval is not certified unrevised point-in-time bytes.
Observed rate changes are not market surprises. Funding expectations, other policy channels and pandemic confounds are not controlled by this bounded design.
A coefficient supported by a single policy date is descriptive and unstable even if the algebraic design is full rank.
negative_absolute_prediction_rule: Report raw linear predictions; no post-hoc clipping.
policy_unit: change_from_previous_observed_bps; first newly observed delta without predecessor remains null and the paired row is excluded, never zero-filled
rank_gate: Both complete-case training designs must have full column rank under exact fraction arithmetic and NumPy tol=1e-10; otherwise no coefficient fitting. Full rank alone does not prove precision or causality.
